backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that defines an Inquiry type and exposes three functions: submitInquiry (stores a new inquiry with timestamp), getAllInquiries (returns all inquiries as an array), and exportInquiriesCsv (returns all inquiries formatted as a CSV string).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single feature that reverts all glassmorphism theme changes from version 14 across all frontend files, listing the affected files and associated components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend file paths to short descriptions summarizing each file's styling approach, components, and responsibilities after the glassmorphism revert.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes, plus global border and background/text defaults.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with full SEO meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD structured data for Nexiris Global, mounting the React app via /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with three routes (Home, AnnualProgram, OurLegacy), a QueryClient provider, and a ModalContext/Layout that manages the global InquiryModal state.
frontend/src/components/annual/FAQSectio: FAQ section for the annual program page using an accordion UI to display six common questions about Nexiris Global's services.
frontend/src/components/annual/PricingSe: Pricing section displaying Single Report and Annual Program cards with feature lists and enquiry CTAs, used on the annual program page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Institutional footer with solid dark background, brand logo, services navigation links, contact email, a gold divider, copyright line, and a caffeine.ai attribution — no glassmorphism styling.
frontend/src/components/home/AnnualProgr: Home page section presenting a condensed two-card pricing comparison (Single Report vs Annual Program) with enquiry and learn-more CTAs.
frontend/src/components/home/Credibility: Home page section showing three animated count-up metric cards (reports delivered, client retention, trade value screened) to establish credibility.
frontend/src/components/home/FinalCTASec: Bottom-of-page call-to-action section with a gold-accented card prompting users to request a report or view the annual program.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Full-screen hero section with a background image, headline, subtext, primary/secondary CTAs, and three key stat badges.
frontend/src/components/home/HowItWorksS: Renders a four-step 'How It Works' section (Submit, Research, Score, Report) with scroll animations, connector lines between steps, and a delivery time callout.
frontend/src/components/home/ProblemSect: Displays three risk cards (Fraud Risk, Financial Exposure, Compliance) with scroll animations to highlight the dangers of unverified trade counterparties.
frontend/src/components/home/TradeScoreS: Shows a sample Trade Trust Score™ of 86 with animated progress bars for five scoring factors alongside a description of the proprietary scoring methodology.
frontend/src/components/home/WhatWeDeliv: Lists eight deliverables included in every Trade Trust Score™ report as animated checklist items in a two-column grid layout.
frontend/src/components/InquiryModal.tsx: Dialog-based inquiry form modal with frosted glass panel styling, a direct email link, a success state with checkmark, and a controlled form that submits via the useSubmitInquiry mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, desktop/mobile layouts, smooth anchor scrolling, and an 'Enquire Now' CTA button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: Custom hook that animates a number from a start value to an end value over a given duration using an ease-out cubic curve, with immediate completion if reduced motion is preferred.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and login status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: useSubmitInquiry for submitting a contact inquiry to the backend, and useGetAllInquiries for fetching all stored inquiries.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set an isVisible flag when a referenced element enters the viewport, with immediate visibility for users who prefer reduced motion.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Montserrat and Inter fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for the dark/gold theme, and provides utility classes for animations, glass effects, gradient text, and button styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AnnualProgram.tsx: Page component for the Annual Program that renders PricingSection and FAQSection with ambient background orbs and wires the modal open action via useModal.
frontend/src/pages/ExportInquiries.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports defined yet.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes all major landing sections (Hero, Problem, TradeScore, WhatWeDeliver, HowItWorks, AnnualProgram, Credibility, FinalCTA) and passes the modal open handler to relevant sections.
frontend/src/pages/OurLegacy.tsx: Our Legacy/About page that displays the company story, four core pillars (Independence, Transparency, Global Reach, Precision), stats, and a CTA section, all with scroll-triggered animations.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with Montserrat/Inter fonts, a gold color scale, nexiris dark palette, custom shadows, border radii, backdrop blurs, and keyframe animations (float, pulse-gold, shimmer).
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the Nexiris Global project at version 3, recording one existing feature (a revert of glassmorphism theme changes) and no new feature requests.
